title: MusicRec: Audio, Lyrics, and Engagement Feature Enrichment for Music Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2606.00125v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Music recommendation systems typically treat songs as opaque tokens, relying on interaction histories that overlook semantic or acoustic content. Prior LLM-augmented, multimodal, and text-enhanced sequential recommenders partially combine semantic, acoustic, or engagement signals, and none jointly model all three within a unified LLM-based framework grounded in song content. In this work, we propose a multimodal framework for session-based music recommendation that enriches the LastFM-1K dataset with three complementary signals: (1) audio and lyric embeddings from pretrained music and text models, (2) LLM-generated semantic metadata using the MGPHot schema, and (3) listening completion ratios. We validate the generated metadata against human MGPHot annotations across all 58 attributes. We extend the E4SRec framework with multimodal features, ItemID encoder backbones including SASRec, BERT4Rec, and GRU4Rec, and LLM backbones inc

translated_title: MusicRec：用于音乐推荐的音频、歌词与互动特征增强
translated_abstract: 音乐推荐系统通常将歌曲视为不透明的标记，依赖于忽略语义或声学内容的交互历史。先前的LLM增强型、多模态以及文本增强型序列推荐器仅部分结合了语义、声学或互动信号，没有任何工作在基于歌曲内容的统一LLM框架内对这三种信号进行联合建模。在本工作中，我们提出了一个用于基于会话的音乐推荐的多模态框架，该框架通过三种互补信号来丰富LastFM-1K数据集：(1) 来自预训练音乐模型和文本模型的音频与歌词嵌入，(2) 使用MGPHot模式生成的LLM语义元数据，以及(3) 听歌完成率。我们针对全部58个属性，将生成的元数据与人工MGPHot标注进行了验证。我们通过多模态特征、包括SASRec、BERT4Rec和GRU4Rec在内的ItemID编码器骨干网络以及LLM骨干网络对E4SRec框架进行了扩展……
tldr: 该论文提出MusicRec——一个基于LLM的多模态音乐推荐框架，首次在统一的、基于歌曲内容的框架内联合建模音频/歌词嵌入、LLM生成的语义元数据和听歌完成率这三种互补信号，从而提升基于会话的音乐推荐效果。
en_tdlr: MusicRec is an LLM-based multimodal framework for session-based music recommendation that, for the first time, jointly models audio/lyric embeddings, LLM-generated semantic metadata, and listening completion ratios within a unified framework grounded in song content.
